title: Mixtral 8x7B Release
summary: Mistral AI released Mixtral 8x7B on December 11, 2023, describing it as a sparse mixture-of-experts model with open weights and licensing it under Apache 2.0.
significance: A dated release milestone for Mistral AI's first open mixture-of-experts model.
